variants.headline: Still in view: bid to remove government fails
variants.sub: The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed.
variants.body:
A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

There are people whose whole interest in this vote is whether it helps them live decently. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
